screen.isekai_mahou.paths.awaken_tip: The bond between the %s class and this element lets you awaken it without the Shrine trial.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.awaken_locked: Requires ritual rank %s (current: %s). Advance your class ritual.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.arcane_tip: Neutral glyphs unlocked by your level (1, 5, 10, 18 and 28).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.arcane_level: Level %s · Circle %s · new glyphs at level %s
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.arcane_desc: Neutral forms, effects, augments and links. They arrive on their own as your level rises (and your Circle, when the glyph asks for it).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_arcane_ti: Arcane glyphs come with your LEVEL
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_arcane_1: • Tiers at levels 1, 5, 10, 18 and 28 (some glyphs also need a Circle).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_arcane_3: • Defeating enemies: in a party, everyone within 24 blocks gets the full XP.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_arcane_4: • Meditating while sneaking still (more with bookshelves nearby), quests and Trials.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_arcane_5: • At the Circle cap your XP is stored and applied after the Ascension.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_cast: • Casting spells with %s glyphs: 2 + cost÷4 per cast (split when the spell mixes elements).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_kill: • Defeating enemies with those spells: target health ÷ 3.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_feats: • Element feats (end of the list): +%s, +%s and +%s at once.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_trials: • Winning Trials: 60 × rank, plus glyphs and loot.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.help_rituals: • Your class rituals and the element's Shrine.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.xp_hint: Raise %s by casting spells with its glyphs and defeating enemies with them. Each Trial you win unlocks a node (see the "?" above).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.convergence_hi: Perform the ritual in the Elemental Plane with both parent elements at Master.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.shrine: Complete the trial at the %s Shrine.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.affinity_prima: Main element of the %s class: it awakens on its own when you pick the class or join the world.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.affinity_hint: Class shortcut: once you reach the ritual rank, use the button below.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.start_trial_de: Takes you to the Trial's Reception hall (friends can join you). Waves of enemies and a boss await in the arena.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.repeat_desc: Challenge: fight again, alone or with friends (half XP and loot).
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.feats_desc: Deeds of the element. Each one grants a big lump of XP at once.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.no_trigger_lef: All movement triggers have already been learned.
screen.isekai_mahou.paths.no_glyphs: No glyphs of this tier registered yet.
paths.isekai_mahou.node.awakening.desc: The element joins your Wheel and you learn its first glyphs.
paths.isekai_mahou.node.apprentice.desc: New effects and an augment of the element.
paths.isekai_mahou.node.adept.desc: Stronger effects and the element's summon.
paths.isekai_mahou.node.fluidity.desc: Unlocks the next movement trigger (sneaking, sprinting, airborne, in water) for your spell variants.
paths.isekai_mahou.node.master.desc: Advanced effects and the right to Convergence (fusions).
paths.isekai_mahou.node.domain.desc: Domain Expansion and the Domain Laws of your Circle.
